moments.title: Strictly's Grand Return
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing begins with its launch show on Saturday, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: New Hosts Debut
angles.copy: Strictly is BACK! The launch show on Saturday sees Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe take over the iconic hosting duties. Ready for the ballroom drama? #Strictly

angles.name: Celebrity Pairings
angles.copy: Who's partnered with who? The Strictly Come Dancing launch this Saturday reveals all the celebrity and pro dancer pairings for the new series. Get ready for sparkles!

angles.name: Anticipation Build
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! Strictly Come Dancing returns to our screens this Saturday at 7:25pm on BBC One. What are you most excited to see?

moments.title: Bake Off's New Ingredient
moments.blurb: The 17th series of The Great British Bake Off starts next Tuesday, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Nigella Joins
angles.copy: Get ready for some delicious drama! The Great British Bake Off is back next Tuesday, and Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood in the judging tent.

angles.name: Tent Reopens
angles.copy: The iconic white tent reopens next Tuesday! The Great British Bake Off Series 17 kicks off at 8pm on Channel 4. Who's your money on for Star Baker?

angles.name: Prue's Replacement
angles.copy: Big shoes to fill! Nigella Lawson steps in for Prue Leith as a new judge on The Great British Bake Off, starting next Tuesday.

moments.title: Wales Women Face Springboks
moments.blurb: The Wales Women's rugby team takes on South Africa at Cardiff Arms Park this Friday in the WXV tournament.

angles.name: Home Game Buzz
angles.copy: Big game in Cardiff this Friday! The Wales Women's rugby team faces South Africa at Cardiff Arms Park. Get down and support the squad! #Rugby #Wales

angles.name: WXV Action
angles.copy: It's WXV action this Friday as Wales Women take on the Springboks at Cardiff Arms Park. Who are you backing for the win?

angles.name: Cardiff Arms Park
angles.copy: Cardiff Arms Park is set for an international clash this Friday as Wales Women host South Africa. Don't miss the action!

moments.title: Laver Cup Hits London
moments.blurb: The Laver Cup, a major international tennis tournament, comes to The O2 in London from September 25-27, with a practice day on Thursday.

angles.name: Tennis in Town
angles.copy: World-class tennis is coming to London! The Laver Cup kicks off at The O2 this Friday, with a practice day on Thursday. Who's excited?

angles.name: Team Europe vs Team World
angles.copy: Get ready for Team Europe vs Team World as the Laver Cup takes over The O2 from Friday. Expect thrilling matches! #Tennis

moments.title: Bare Knuckle Fighting in Manchester
moments.blurb: BKFC 94, featuring Till vs. Romero, is set for the AO Arena in Manchester this Saturday.

angles.name: Fight Night Manchester
angles.copy: Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship is back! BKFC 94 takes over Manchester's AO Arena this Saturday with Till vs. Romero. Get ready for some intense action!

angles.name: Till vs Romero
angles.copy: Darren Till vs Yoel Romero headlines BKFC 94 at the AO Arena this Saturday. Manchester, are you ready for this fight?

moments.title: Thompson Twins' Tom Bailey Live
moments.blurb: Tom Bailey of Thompson Twins fame performs at The O2 in London this Saturday.

angles.name: 80s Icon in London
angles.copy: Get your 80s fix! Thompson Twins' Tom Bailey brings his hits to The O2 in London this Saturday. Who's joining him?

angles.name: Hold Me Now
angles.copy: Relive the 80s with Tom Bailey! The voice of Thompson Twins is at The O2 this Saturday. What's your favourite TT track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Fee Waybill
moments.blurb: Fee Waybill, lead singer of American rock band The Tubes, turns 76 tomorrow, September 17.

angles.name: The Tubes Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday tomorrow to Fee Waybill, the legendary frontman of The Tubes! What's your favourite song from the band?

angles.name: Glam Rock Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Fee Waybill's 76th birthday tomorrow! The glam rock icon from The Tubes brought us some unforgettable tracks.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joanne Catherall
moments.blurb: Joanne Catherall, singer with British synth-pop legends The Human League, turns 64 this Friday, September 18.

angles.name: Human League Voice
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday this Friday to Joanne Catherall, one of the iconic voices of The Human League! Don't You Want Her?

angles.name: Synth-Pop Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Joanne Catherall's 64th birthday this Friday! A true synth-pop star and key member of The Human League. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Joan Jett
moments.blurb: Rock icon Joan Jett, known for 'I Love Rock 'n Roll' and The Runaways, celebrates her 68th birthday next Tuesday, September 22.

angles.name: Godmother of Punk
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday next Tuesday to the 'Godmother of Punk', Joan Jett! Still loving rock 'n' roll after all these years.

angles.name: Rock 'n Roll Queen
angles.copy: Next Tuesday, we celebrate the 68th birthday of rock legend Joan Jett! From The Runaways to The Blackhearts, she's a true icon.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Andrea Bocelli
moments.blurb: World-renowned Italian tenor Andrea Bocelli turns 68 next Tuesday, September 22.

angles.name: Tenor's Birthday
angles.copy: Next Tuesday, we wish a very Happy 68th Birthday to the incredible Andrea Bocelli! What's your favourite of his timeless songs?

angles.name: Classical Crossover
angles.copy: Celebrating the 68th birthday of the magnificent Andrea Bocelli next Tuesday! His voice crosses genres and touches hearts worldwide.

moments.title: Happy Birthday The Boss
moments.blurb: Bruce Springsteen, 'The Boss', the legendary American singer-songwriter, celebrates his 77th birthday next Wednesday, September 23.

angles.name: The Boss Turns 77
angles.copy: Next Wednesday, we're celebrating the 77th birthday of rock legend Bruce Springsteen! What's the ultimate 'Boss' anthem for you?

angles.name: Born to Run
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday next Wednesday to 'The Boss'! Bruce Springsteen's music defines generations. What's your favourite album?

moments.title: Scale the Stadium Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 'Scale the Stadium' charity event returns to Cardiff's Principality Stadium this Sunday, offering zip-lining and abseiling experiences.

angles.name: Zip-line the Pitch
angles.copy: Dare to zip-line across the Principality Stadium pitch this Sunday? 'Scale the Stadium' is back in Cardiff for charity!

angles.name: Abseil for Charity
angles.copy: Conquer the Principality Stadium this Sunday by abseiling its exterior for a great cause at 'Scale the Stadium'. A unique way to see Cardiff!
